paragraph.ribbon.spacingTip: Character spacing as a percent of each character's own width (HWP style)
paragraph.title: Paragraph
paragraph.sub: The values apply to the selected paragraphs (or the whole text box when it is not being edited) in one step.
paragraph.noText: Select a text box or edit text first.
paragraph.line.multipleTip: Times the font's single line height (1 = single, as DOCX multiple line spacing). New documents use 1.08.
paragraph.flowNote: A page break before applies at once. Keep with next and keep lines together are saved into DOCX and HWPX files; Omniweave does not flow text across pages while you edit yet.
list.title: Bullets, numbering and heading numbering
list.sub: Picking a style applies it to the selected paragraphs; picking the same style again removes the list. While editing, Tab and Shift+Tab change the level.
list.textTip: %1 is the level 1 number, %2 the level 2 number (e.g. %1.%2.).
list.levelNote: Applying changes every item of this level in the list.
paragraph.line.percentTip: Percent of the font size (HWP/HWPX documents and older Omniweave documents; 160% was the old default).
paragraph.ribbon.linePctTip: Line spacing: percent of the font size (HWP-style paragraph)
